title: Point geometry
hints: Read fields with a dot: `p.X`, `q.Y`. The horizontal distance is `q.X - p.X`, the vertical one `q.Y - p.Y`.
`Distance` is `math.Hypot(q.X-p.X, q.Y-p.Y)`. `Midpoint` is a keyed literal: `Point{X: (p.X + q.X) / 2, Y: (p.Y + q.Y) / 2}`.
`p` is a copy, so `Translate` may do `p.X += dx; p.Y += dy; return p`. For `Centroid`, return early on `len(points) == 0`, sum into `var sum Point`, then divide each field by `float64(len(points))`.
